notes.title: BOOMSTOCK 2025 starts today!
notes.content:
[p]It’s time to lock, load, and dive headfirst into the loudest, fastest, and most explosive corner of gaming – the realm of boomer shooters![/p][p][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Boomstock2025][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/d1b0faaa5542d8a8d8f47e9f9704a0c1c6f0d63a.png"][/img][/url][/p][p]Until [b]September 27[/b], we’re celebrating the genre that never dies: blistering speed, oversized arsenals, brutal enemies, and that glorious retro feel. BOOMSTOCK brings together the best of old-school action with today’s wild new twists.[/p][p]To mark the occasion, NECROVISION is being discounted by 85% for the entire duration of the event.[/p][p]Besides that, we’ve got a special milestone that we’d like to talk about: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1409200/HYPERVIOLENT/"]HYPERVIOLENT[/url][b] has officially left Early Access and is now fully released![/b] There’s no better time to jump in and experience the complete, blood-soaked chaos.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="rEZH2KYG-Lw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s waiting for you this week:[/p][list][*][p]Play brand-new demos of upcoming boomer shooters and action-packed indie FPS.[/p][/*][*][p]Watch fresh trailers & announcements straight from the developers keeping the retro spirit alive.[/p][/*][*][p]Grab huge discounts on classic favorites and modern heavy-hitters in the genre.[/p][/*][*][p]Discover hidden gems that deserve a spot in your library. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Whether you’re a die-hard Quake veteran, a Doom-slaying purist, or just curious about what “boomer shooters” are all about – this is your festival.[/p][p]So strap in, keep your finger on the trigger, and get ready for a full week of non-stop action. [/p][p][b]BOOMSTOCK is live now – let’s make some noise![/b][/p][p]
And if you want to be an even bigger part of the BOOMSTOCK community, hop on the official [u][url="https://discord.gg/mn2t5dQDTk"]Discord server[/url][/u], where you’ll be able to find all the news and even giveaways![/p]

And that is not all, since we figured that Necrovision players might enjoy the FPS genre in general, we're also [b]giving away two Steam keys[/b] of another game published by Fulqrum Publishing, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1406780/Viscerafest/]Viscerafest[/url]. Good luck and don't forget to tell your friends as well!

notes.title: Forgive Me Father 2 is Out of Early Access Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

Allow us to inform you, loyal players of Necrovision, that another first-person-shooter from Fulqrum Publishing has just left Early Access and is available now - the game is none other than [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272250/Forgive_Me_Father_2/]Forgive Me Father 2[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272250/Forgive_Me_Father_2/

Drawing inspiration from various FPS subgenres, including classic boomer shooters like Quake and Doom, combined with modern mechanics, unique visual style, and Unreal Engine 5 technology, [b]Forgive Me Father 2 offers an action-packed retro-meets-cutting-edge love letter to all FPS fans[/b]. 

Building upon the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590910/Forgive_Me_Father/]original[/url] with a darker story, players are now entrenched deeper into the mythos, with equipable [b]Dark Tome[/b] pages to upgrade their madness skills. Be that healing wounds with [b]Lifesteal[/b], becoming more powerful with [b]Might[/b], boosting fire rate and reload speed with [b]Haste[/b], or reducing incoming damage with [b]Resistance[/b], players can give their mind to the eldritch apparitions to improve their chances of survival. 

While Forgive Me Father 2 has seen multiple major updates over its Early Access period, today’s 1.0 launch introduces [b]tons of new content including vast new levels, new weapons, eldritch monstrosities to battle, and much, much more[/b]!

Starting from today, players will be able to explore the suitably-named Nightmare Land, a low-gravity Hellscape filled with gigantic mushrooms, and of course, hordes of Lovecraftian monstrosities ready to devour their flesh and soul. If mushrooms aren’t your thing, why not face the chilly horrors of the new Arctic level, which also launches as part of today’s 1.0 release?

Players will also be able to get their hands on new tools of destruction, such as the melee weapon known as ‘The Suspicious Box’, which clears theirs personal space when surrounded by hideous monstrosities. Or if you’d prefer, why not kill enemies through sight alone? Then you’ll love the latest addition to the Dark Tome system, which wounds enemies within your sight at unbelievable frequency. No one is safe as long as you have a clear line of sight to your target. 

Get Forgive Me Father 2 for a discounted price and if you think playing the second installment without even trying the first one, be informed that there is a bundle that includes both of these games and that offers a bundle discount (this discount applies even if you already own one of the included games).

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35903/Forgive_Me_Father_Franchise_Bundle/

We greet you, fans of Lovecraft's world,

This event hosted by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/FulqrumPublishing/]Fulqrum Publishing[/url] brings you a collection of many Lovecraftian games that you can get with sizable discounts. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/FulqrumPublishing/sale/Lovecraftian_Days_2023]Take a look at the whole list of participating games by clicking this link[/url].

[b]Necrovision[/b] is, of course, also included! You can get the game for [b]85 % off[/b]. And if you purchase it in a bundle, the discount applies there as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5161/Zombie_TriplePack/


[h3]And to celebrate this important moment, we have some special news to share with all the Lovecraftian fans.[/h3]

First of all, today we are launching [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1409200/HYPERVIOLENT/][b]HYPERVIOLENT[/b][/url], an atmospheric horror retro-FPS, into Early Access. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1409200/view/3708192458217527573]Follow the link to read about all the details[/url].

We are also hugely stoked to announce, that the successful Lovecraftian retro-FPS [b]Forgive Me Father[/b] will get a successor. [url=https://twitter.com/ByteBarrel][b]Byte Barrel[/b][/url] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/FulqrumPublishing/]Fulqrum Publishing[/url][/b] are joining forces again to bring you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272250/Forgive_Me_Father_2/?beta=1][b]Forgive Me Father 2[/b][/url]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272250/Forgive_Me_Father_2

That's it for today! Now go and enjoy your favorite Lovecraftian games!

notes.title: Retro-FPS lovers, Dread Templar has arrived!
notes.content:
We greet you, fans of the most legendary game genre!

There is never enough boomer-shooters, and one of the most anticipated retro first-person-shooters has just left Early Access, that being none other than [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1334730/Dread_Templar/][b]Dread Templar[/b][/url].

The full version of the game is a rough trip through hell, on which you'll be constantly interrupted by 20+ types of enemies and 9 bosses. Don't you worry though, for your dearest companions are dual-wielded pistols, shotguns, rocket launchers, katanas (which also can be thrown as a spear) and many more - all of which can be further upgraded in more than 100 ways!

So what do you say, are you brave enough to take the trip?

During the first week after launch, Dread Templar is 15% off, so there's nothing to wait for, get the game right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1334730/Dread_Templar/
